test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

__Unless he has permission from his parent__s, he wouldn't travel alone.

options.text: If he had permission from his parents,
Unless he had permission from his parents,
Unless he had permitted by his parents,

solution:
The correct answer is: **Unless he had permission from his parents,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the original sentence, the verb "**wouldn't travel**" is in the past tense
